decisions.reason: The homepage routing clarification does not change how future locations are added or templated.
Routing visitors from the master homepage to either website remains compatible with the existing separate-location-website model and does not change it.
The source identifies the Shatter House USA site as the homepage but does not change its established domain mapping.
The location-selection routing decision does not alter the separate Wix-account requirement.
Mentioning the Shatter House USA site identifies the routing surface but does not change any branding requirement.
The selector leading to either website is consistent with the existing master-site linkage, while the source does not change legacy-site availability.
The source changes homepage routing and activity presentation, not responsive or mobile behavior.
The instruction to retain the existing activity listing does not replace or modify the established visual design reference.
The same-message MODIFY already records the instruction to list activities as currently shown; the location-selection clause belongs to the routing Requirement.
The selector helps visitors reach the appropriate booking website but does not change the existing placement or isolation of booking systems.
Homepage location routing does not alter separate location calendars or their placement.
The source does not change location-specific analytics, reporting, revenue, or sales isolation.
